unknowns: No pad activation, lift power change, door opening, or route clear is observed.
The middle PAC label is partially obscured by the orange curtain, so its exact wording is not inferred.
Earlier idle cues are exposure only, not practice.
Single-operator extra demands are excluded from two-human scores.
